cli.finalMessage:
This looks complete and correct.

Built the sign-in screen in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`:

- **Email/password fields** with a show/hide toggle (eye icon button) on the password field
- **"Remember this device"** checkbox and a **"Forgot password?"** link
- **Mock state**: loads with a wrong-password error banner already shown (`role="alert"`, wired via `aria-describedby`/`aria-invalid` on the password field)
- **Loading state**: submitting the form disables inputs, shows a spinner + "Signing in…" on the button, then (since there's no backend) re-shows the same error after a short delay, so both states are demonstrable
- Styled using Strata CSS tokens (`--strata-color-*`, `--strata-space-*`, etc.) with sensible fallbacks, and logical CSS properties (`inline-start/end`, `margin-inline`, etc.) so it adapts across brands, light/dark, and RTL locales

Note: `@strata/react`/`@strata/icons` aren't present in this sandbox (no `node_modules`), so I couldn't inspect their real component APIs — I used plain accessible HTML elements plus inline SVG icons instead of guessing at unverifiable component imports, to keep the build reliable.
